notes.title: Inertial Drift: Twilight Rivals Pack - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36398504/b9073e2025a455d4acab0a3d059f106ce1ed1f85.png[/img]

Hey all,

We're happy to say that [b]Inertial Drift: Twilight Rivals Pack is out now! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36398504/5192e1b9bde7b7deb72da5997d2eb1c5f58e0222.gif[/img]

Inertial Drift fans on PC, PlayStation 4 Xbox One & Nintendo Switch can enjoy fresh content with the 'Twilight Rivals Pack', coming stacked with: 

[list]
[*] Brand new 'Twilight Rivals' single player story mode.
[*] All-new Eurobeat Soundtrack, mixed by renowned producer '[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FciLaexQ9-8]Turbo[/url]'
[*] Four tracks, including reversible routes.
[*] Four new cars, all exclusively unique from each other!
[*] And more!
[/list]

'Inertial Drift Twilight Rivals Pack' for PC, PlayStation 4 and Xbox One releases alongside 'Inertial Drift Twilight Rivals Edition' for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X. Nintendo Switch DLC content will be releasing later this year. 

Upgrade to Inertial Drift, and then grab the DLC today!:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1184480/Inertial_Drift/

notes.title: INERTIAL DRIFT IS EVOLVING!
notes.content:
[h1]WELCOME TO UPDATE #1![/h1]
We're really happy to announce today that big changes are coming to Inertial Drift - but before we get to that, we have to say a huge thank you to everyone who has shown support, bought, downloaded, wishlisted or reviewed Inertial drift. 

Over the past year, we've been thinking about how we can improve and grow the overall experience and today is the first day of that journey into expanding the Inertial Drift universe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36398504/8fe11ac0215f0572dcf6dcedad9f15a0cfe16c86.png[/img]

As some of you will have noticed there are some changes to the current roster, specifically;

- The original Roton 7D is now Class B with updated handling.
- We've also added a New upgraded Roton 7D Super for Class A.

In the coming months we will release a further three upgraded cars to the roster as well. We're currently aiming to have one added to Inertial Drift every month.

Perhaps most importantly however, we have overhauled the leaderboards. From today, there are new individual Time Attack Leaderboards for each car - it's a big move and will hopefully be the groundwork Inertial Drift needed to make this part of the game more compelling and competitive - allowing you to prove your worth with each individual car against other players globally.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36398504/4b923c24f383d0dd4e417b4bbceb23b69a0255c7.jpg[/img]

Now that this groundwork has been completed - what are the next steps?

We're looking forward to rolling these out into next year, so please bear with us for more specific details on the roadmap - but they will include; 

- New tracks! 
- Brand new cars 
- Expanded single player content.
- Visual Improvements
- And some nice surprises!

If you're only just arriving at Inertial Drift, you'll find the game current discounted in store, so there's never been a better time to join us and find out what makes Inertial Drift so unique. We hope you enjoy your time with us and join us for the long road ahead.

Take care and all the best,
The Level 91 and PQube team.

notes.title: Developer Update - Restarts are now in!
notes.content:
Due to popular demand the very-sensible option of mid-race restarts has now been added.

[previewyoutube=RudxXu4ujpk;full][/previewyoutube]

Hopefully this will make quitting in and out to try for those times a bit more efficient! 
As ever, any further feedback, please let us know and we'll see what we can do!
Best,
The Level 91 and PQube teams.
